mapper.select: SELECT CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id, o.voucher_id AS session_id, o.title_snapshot AS session_title, o.admission_code, o.status+0 AS status, o.use_time AS checked_in_at, s.id AS event_id, s.name AS event_name, s.venue_name, s.address, v.session_starts_at FROM tb_voucher_order o JOIN tb_voucher v ON v.id = o.voucher_id JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = o.shop_id_snapshot WHERE o.user_id = #{owner} AND o.admission_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_voucher_order o JOIN tb_voucher v ON v.id = o.voucher_id SET o.status = 3, o.use_time = #{now}, o.checked_in_by = #{operator} WHERE o.admission_code = #{code} AND o.status = 2 AND #{now} >= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -30, v.session_starts_at) AND #{now} < v.session_ends_at
